description: empira/PDFsharp issues and pull requests triaged against FreePDF 7.7.0 (d889ee8) on 2026-11-05. Only issue and PR text was read, never diffs or upstream source. 'freepdf' is the result for FreePDF; summaries are our own words.

items.title: XMP metadata is not XML-escaped: '&' or '<' in Title or Author produce malformed XMP
items.summary: When XMP is generated (PDF/A, PDF/UA, Factur-X), Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Producer and Creator are interpolated into the packet without XML escaping or removal of control characters, so a title like 'Profit & Loss <2026>' makes the XMP malformed and the PDF/A invalid.

items.title: Form flattening, auto-size text-field appearance, and a font-resolver requirement when reading AcroForm fields
items.summary: Reported that reading 6.2.4 text fields needed a font resolver and that flattening and auto-size (/DA size 0) appearances were missing; in FreePDF the bug is gone and Flatten() and auto-size appearances exist, only helpers to remove a field or replace it with an image are missing.

items.title: Fixes and improvements (incl. rich tables borders)
items.summary: A list of fixes and MigraDoc hooks from another fork; in FreePDF four of the listed bugs reproduce (positive /Descent, wrong ToUnicode for characters above U+FFFF, opening changes the in-memory ModDate, saving to the input stream appends a second PDF), two are already fixed (hex-string EOF, Adler-32), top-down BMP and blank-glyph subsets behave correctly, and the table-border, layout-hook and Windows font-collection items are feature gaps.

items.title: Vulnerabilities in System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs <= 8.0.1
items.summary: Referencing the package pulls in System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs 8.0.1 with known advisories (NU1902/NU1903); the reporter also asks for a package without the cryptography dependency.

items.title: Bold simulation adds 0.02 em character spacing per character; please make it configurable
items.summary: Simulated bold uses a fixed internal 0.02 em for both the stroke width and extra character spacing (Tc) on every glyph, so simulated-bold text is wider than regular text and cannot be made to match Word; the request is public settings for both factors.

items.title: Text is not shown - alpha must be set explicitly
items.summary: Text drawn with new XColor { R, G, B } is invisible because alpha stays 0; this is by design, FreePDF behaves the same and XColor.FromArgb(r, g, b) gives an opaque colour.

items.title: FlateDecode.Encode writes zlib streams without the Adler-32 trailer (RFC 1950)
items.summary: Flate-encoded streams lacked the 4-byte Adler-32 trailer required by RFC 1950, so strict zlib decoders rejected them (e.g. Factur-X attachments).

items.title: Stack overflow in PdfReader.Open when a stream's indirect /Length refers back to the stream being read
items.summary: A stream whose indirect /Length refers to itself, or two streams whose lengths refer to each other, overflowed the stack in PdfReader.Open; FreePDF opens both in Modify and Import mode and recovers the length from endstream.

items.title: OutOfMemoryException in Parser.ReadTrailer() when opening a valid ~1 GiB PDF
items.summary: If 'startxref' is not within the last 1030 bytes, ReadTrailer reads the whole file into one .NET string, which costs about five times the file size in allocations and throws OutOfMemoryException for files above about 1 GiB (NotImplementedException above 2 GiB).

items.title: PdfReader.Open throws NotImplementedException: "File streams are not yet implemented" on PDF generated by ChatGPT
items.summary: A stream dictionary with an external file (/F) made the whole document fail to open with NotImplementedException.

items.title: MigraDoc FontHandler's single-entry font cache is racy: concurrent rendering silently returns the wrong font
items.summary: MigraDoc's last-font cache kept the Font and XFont in two separately written static fields, so concurrent rendering could return another document's font size.

items.title: PdfSharp 6.2.3's PdfDocument.Save() unconditionally stamps a page-level /Group {/S /Transparency /CS /DeviceRGB} onto every output page, even when the source page has none.
items.summary: Every saved page without a /Group gets a page-level transparency group (DeviceRGB, or DeviceCMYK in CMYK mode), also for pages of opened or imported documents that never used transparency; only Append mode, PDF/A and ColorMode.Undefined skip it.

items.title: Access restrictions are enforced inconsistently: Modify open is blocked without the owner password, but Import page copying from the same document is not
items.summary: Opening an owner-password-only document in Modify mode without the password is refused, but Import mode lets every page be copied into a new unencrypted document regardless of the extract/assemble permissions; the reporter asks for opt-in enforcement or clearer documentation (upstream says it works as intended).

items.title: PdfReaderException "Name expected" in ReadDictionary on invalid pdfTeX-generated PDFs containing dictionary entries without valid key
items.summary: pdfTeX's Info dictionary has a bare string where a name key belongs ((PTEX.FullBanner) (...)), and the reader threw 'Name expected' for the whole file.

items.title: Bold style is not applied for some windows fonts
items.summary: With the WPF build, Bold for Cascadia Code or Bahnschrift (single variable-font files whose Bold is a named instance) renders as regular, because WPF reports a real Bold face and the embedded file only has the default (regular) outlines.

items.title: Chinese chars are not measured correctly
items.summary: Text in a font that lacks the glyphs (CJK in Courier New) is measured with .notdef widths and not drawn; PDFsharp 1.3 relied on GDI font substitution, and FreePDF has no automatic per-glyph font fallback.

items.title: PNG Loading Failure in PdfSharp After Installing System.Formats.Nrbf and System.Resources.Extensions Libraries
items.summary: PNG import reportedly failed with 'Unsupported image format' once System.Formats.Nrbf and System.Resources.Extensions 10.0.8 were referenced; with both packages referenced FreePDF imports PNGs from file and stream.

items.title: License link in README redirects to 404 Not Found
items.summary: The license link in upstream's README redirected to a 404 page on docs.pdfsharp.net; upstream website only.

items.title: XImage.FromStream swallows all PNG decode exceptions as "Unsupported image format."
items.summary: PNG decode failures are reported only as InvalidOperationException 'Unsupported image format.' without the original exception; FreePDF already lets OutOfMemoryException through, but other decode errors (corrupt data, IO) still lose their cause.

items.title: Bug: Name objects with non-UTF-8 byte sequences (Shift-JIS, GBK, etc.) cause garbled text when reading PDF
items.summary: PDF names with legacy multibyte bytes were decoded as UTF-8 only, missing 0x80-0xBF lead bytes and replacing invalid sequences with U+FFFD.

items.title: Error splitting PDF with PDFSharp 7 vs 6.2.4
items.summary: Importing a page whose /Rotate (as pdf-lib writes it) is an indirect reference to an integer object crashes AddPage with NullReferenceException in the transitive-closure walk, which only handles dictionaries and arrays.

items.title: PdfMetadata.GenerateXmp() throws when /Info fields are malformed (e.g., non-string or invalid object references)
items.summary: Saving a document whose /Info entries are not strings (number, array, dictionary) or point to missing objects throws InvalidOperationException whenever XMP metadata is generated (MetadataManager AutoGenerate or SetPdfA()); the default save works, and the Info.Title/Author/Subject/Keywords/CreationDate getters throw too.

items.title: Missing spaces when copying text from PDF created with MigraDoc & PdfSharp
items.summary: MigraDoc places every word with its own Td and Tj and never writes space characters, so viewers that do not infer spaces from gaps (the old Edge viewer) copy text without spaces; Poppler and MuPDF infer them.

items.title: Cannot open PDF: Unexpected character '0x0052' in PDF stream.
items.summary: A single reference with a very large object number (e.g. '/Pg 910491793 0 R', beyond the PDF maximum) makes the whole document fail to open instead of being treated as a reference to a missing object (null).

items.title: pdf A-3B
items.summary: SetPdfA on an existing non-PDF/A file adds OutputIntents and MarkInfo but leaves the content non-conforming: link annotations keep no /F Print flag, and if the file already has an XMP packet it is kept without pdfaid, so the output does not even claim PDF/A; converting arbitrary input to PDF/A is beyond the current design.

items.title: Field name returns string.Empty when signature reason contains Japanese characters
items.summary: Reading field names (6.x AcroForm Names) returned empty strings for a signed document whose signature Reason is Japanese; the reporter later attributes it to the structure in upstream #213, without a sample file.

items.title: Font Resolver can't resolve error font
items.summary: MigraDoc error-font failure reported by a PdfSharpCore user whose resolver returned one face; not this library (FreePDF 7.2.0 also no longer needs a resolver for Courier New).

items.title: Serious error in .NET SDK 10.0.201 when building the PDFsharp solution
items.summary: Building the solution with .NET SDK 10.0.201/10.0.2xx takes many minutes instead of about a minute, apparently due to the three projects that link the same ~450 files across four target frameworks; the workaround is pinning SDK 10.0.1xx with global.json.

items.title: Can't Open File (PdfSharp.Pdf.IO.ObjectNotAvailableException)
items.summary: A stream with a correct /Length followed by many line feeds before 'endstream' (as IBM i invoice generators write) cannot be read: the endstream search window is only /Length + 20 bytes, so the whole document fails to open.

items.title: HasOwnerPermissions doesn't work as documented
items.summary: PdfSecuritySettings.HasOwnerPermissions had an internal getter and a public setter; FreePDF (from MIT 7.0 Preview 1) has HasFullPermission { get; internal set; } instead.

items.title: Rendering issues with hyphenated text in lists
items.summary: A justified MigraDoc list paragraph containing soft hyphens can send layout into an endless loop (100% CPU, never returns) at ordinary indents; the reporter's second symptom (lost word spaces on the first line) did not show in the cases that finished.

items.title: Error code: '0000004294967295'
items.summary: Three PDFs fail to open with an unexpected token '0000004294967295' (0xFFFFFFFF); no file was shared.

items.title: Height and Width Swapped in PDF Sharp 6.2.0 and Above on Some PDFs.
items.summary: XPdfForm.PointWidth/PointHeight return the media box size (not swapped for /Rotate 90/270) since 6.2.0; documented breaking change, FreePDF behaves the same.

items.title: Orientation is not working with PdfSharp and Migra-Doc 6.2.4 version
items.summary: Duplicate of #246: landscape ignored after cloning DefaultPageSetup; by design, call ResetPageSize() after Clone().

items.title: There is no data and the rows have become taller.
items.summary: Table rows without data render taller than expected; only screenshots, no code or document.

items.title: Error 'System.InvalidOperationException: 'Byte[]' must not be null here.'
items.summary: XGraphics.FromPdfPage on some valid but unusual pages threw "'Byte[]' must not be null here"; fixed upstream in 6.2.4 (FreePDF's baseline), and the later variant with null /DecodeParms (PR #399) is fixed in FreePDF 7.6.1.

items.title: Radial gradients and extended gradients are not rendered
items.summary: XRadialGradientBrush fills come out solid black in PDF output and ExtendLeft/ExtendRight are ignored on gradient brushes.

items.title: Exception rendering GDI+ JPEG images
items.summary: Drawing an XImage made from a GDI+ JPEG threw NullReferenceException because no image data was copied; fixed upstream in 6.2.3 (baseline); GDI build cannot be probed on Linux.

items.title: Exception when PdfReader.Open method executed
items.summary: Random PDFs fail with an unexpected token in an indirect object; no file was shared.

items.title: Orientation.Landscape does not work anymore
items.summary: Setting PageSetup.Orientation = Landscape gives a landscape page; only a PageSetup cloned from DefaultPageSetup (which already carries PageWidth/PageHeight) stays portrait, which is the documented behaviour, fixed by ResetPageSize().

items.title: Change Request: Improve Form Field Handling When Merging PDFs
items.summary: Request to rename duplicate form-field names automatically when merging PDFs so all fields stay usable.

items.title: Merge Docs from Bytes
items.summary: Merging stamped and flattened PDFs loaded from byte arrays repeated the first page for every page.

items.title: XImage.FromFile/FromStream throws InvalidOperationException (Unsupported image format.) for valid JPGs
items.summary: Duplicate of #304: valid JPEGs with stuffed 0xFF00 bytes were rejected as unsupported; the reporter's JPEG imports in FreePDF.

items.title: MigraDoc Chart Legend does not Word Wrap
items.summary: A chart legend with many or long entries is laid out on one line and runs off both sides of the page; there is no wrapping or multi-row legend.

items.title: Need Custom Updates
items.summary: MigraDoc charts: X-axis tick labels overlap (no rotation or skipping) and the legend does not wrap; the legend part duplicates #306.

items.title: PdfSharp fails to import a jpeg file - MoveToNextHeader moves over EOF
items.summary: The JPEG importer treated a stuffed 0xFF00 after the scan header as a segment and read past the end of the file; fixed upstream in 6.2.4 (baseline).

items.title: PDFSharp fails to open a document, created by PDFSharp when document contains a JPEG image made from a MemoryStream
items.summary: A JPEG loaded from a MemoryStream whose capacity exceeds its length produced a PDF that PDFsharp itself could not reopen.

items.title: MigraDoc Legend formatting
items.summary: Chart legends with many or long entries run off the page because they do not wrap; duplicate of open upstream #306.

items.title: Serializing a `CArray` results in a broken document.
items.summary: CArray was serialized without separators between elements, breaking content rewritten with ReplaceContent; fixed upstream in 6.2.4 (baseline).

items.title: PDFsharp vs PdfSharpCore
items.summary: Asks how PDFsharp differs from the PdfSharpCore port.

items.title: Error when parsing some PDF/UA documents (an object with the same key has already been added)
items.summary: A PDF/UA file with two objects of the same ID in an object stream failed with a duplicate key; fixed upstream in 2025 (6.2.x, baseline).

items.title: PDF/A-1b bug with local characters
items.summary: With SetPdfA() (PDF/A-1b), text outside WinAnsi is written as a CID font subset without the CIDSet stream PDF/A-1 requires, so the file fails validation.

items.title: How to render property non Latin characters?
items.summary: Greek text was blank because the chosen font lacks Greek glyphs; a comment asks for right-to-left (bidi) reordering, which FreePDF does not do either (no complex-script shaping claim).

items.title: Digital signature is broken in DEBUG mode
items.summary: Signatures made by a DEBUG build were invalid because debug comments shifted the signed byte range; fixed upstream in 6.2.2 (baseline). FreePDF's Release build signs correctly also with the verbose writer layout, which adds comments.

items.title: Errors: Could not load file or assembly 'PDFSharp-gdi, Version=6.2.1.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=f94615aa0424f9eb'. The system can't find the especified file.
items.summary: A WinForms app could not load PdfSharp-gdi 6.2.1 from a class library; deployment issue.

items.title: Failed to open a document due to an incorrect log string format
items.summary: A malformed log template in PdfObjectID threw FormatException when an out-of-range object ID was logged; fixed upstream in 6.2.3 (baseline).

items.title: "Bug report: Crash on PDFs exactly 1030 bytes long — ArgumentOutOfRangeException in ReadTrailer()
items.summary: A PDF exactly 1030 bytes long threw ArgumentOutOfRangeException in ReadTrailer; fixed upstream in 6.2.1 (baseline).

items.title: Rendering Line Chart using PdfSharp.Charting when Series.Visible = false is assigned
items.summary: A line series whose LineFormat.Visible is false is still drawn, as a hairline, because the converter turns it into a zero-width pen instead of skipping the line.

items.title: Rendering Chart using PdfSharp.Charting when several XSeries are added
items.summary: Adding a second XSeries to a PdfSharp.Charting chart draws its category labels outside the plot area and even outside the chart frame.

items.title: PDF saving thows an exception when PDF with hyperlink has an owner password set
items.summary: Saving a MigraDoc document with a hyperlink and only an owner password threw InvalidOperationException; fixed upstream in 6.2.1 (baseline).

items.title: PdfReader.Open takes an excessive amount of time
items.summary: PdfReader.Open took minutes on some files in 6.1.1; the reporter confirmed 6.2.0 fixed it.

items.title: Regression V6.2 - Page orientation
items.summary: Duplicate of #271: setting Size after Orientation resets the orientation since 6.2.0; by design.

items.title: XFA NeedsRendering Flag cannot be found
items.summary: How to set the catalog's optional /NeedsRendering flag for XFA forms; it can be added through the catalog's Elements (FreePDF has only the key constant).

items.title: Compatibility between Java PDFBox and PDFSharp - Encryption.
items.summary: An AES-256 file encrypted by PDFBox reportedly failed to open with 'Indirect reference without value.'

items.title: Optimising merged PDFs to reduce file size through duplicated resources
items.summary: Request to share identical fonts and images when pages from many separate source files are merged, so the result is not much larger than one generated file.

items.title: Could not load file or assembly 'Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions, Version=8.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=adb9793829ddae60'
items.summary: Duplicate of #242: COM-visible .NET Framework DLL cannot load Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions 8.0.0; binding redirects in the host.

items.title: InvalidOperationException: The font 'Courier New' cannot be resolved for predefined error font. (after upgrading MigraDoc 6.1.1 => 6.2.0)
items.summary: MigraDoc 6.2.0 stopped with 'The font Courier New cannot be resolved for predefined error font' without a font resolver; FreePDF 7.2.0 uses installed fonts and metric-compatible substitutes.

items.title: The DLLs part of the NuGet package are not signed
items.summary: Asks for Authenticode-signed DLLs; FreePDF assemblies are strong-named with io7's key but carry no Authenticode or NuGet author signature.

items.title: Page orientenation reset after setting page.Size
items.summary: Setting page.Size after page.Orientation gives a portrait page; documented 6.2.0 breaking change, FreePDF behaves the same (its own docs do not mention it).

items.title: Inconsistency when iterating over a PdfAcroFieldCollection
items.summary: foreach over the AcroForm field collection yielded PdfItem while the indexer returned typed fields.

items.title: Merged PDFs Lose Form Fields from Second Document in Adobe Reader
items.summary: Merging two forms with the same field names lost the second form's fields in Acrobat; FreePDF's AppendPages renames clashing fields (AddPage(page) still drops forms, as in 6.2.4).

items.title: UserPassword stopped working in 6.x series in Edge
items.summary: Edge's new PDF viewer rejected user-password files because the V4 encryption dictionary had no /Length; 6.2.4 (baseline) always writes it.

items.title: MigraDocDocs error: No appropriate font found for family name 'times new roman'
items.summary: A MigraDocDocs sample used 'times new roman' and the samples' case-sensitive font resolver failed; samples repository, not the library.

items.title: Adobe Acrobat Pro raises "Insufficient data for an image." error
items.summary: Acrobat reported 'Insufficient data for an image' for a PNG whose colour bits are all zero; FreePDF writes the image as a complete zlib stream (Adler-32, final block), likely the cause, but Acrobat is not available here to confirm.

items.title: PdfSharp DLLs loading in multiple .net versions
items.summary: Duplicate of #242: plug-in on .NET Framework cannot load Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions; needs binding redirects.

items.title: Some valid JPEG files may not be loaded using XImage.FromFile()
items.summary: JPEG files without a JFIF APP0 header were rejected by XImage.FromFile.

items.title: UserPassword stopped working in 6.2.0-preview-3
items.summary: On .NET Framework, user-password files from 6.2.0 Preview 3 could not be opened in Acrobat or Chrome; fixed upstream in 6.2.0 final (baseline), and FreePDF replaced the MD5 helper with its own RFC 1321 code tested on Framework CI.

items.title: Data query and security settings errors.
items.summary: A field's /Rect read as null after walking page annotations, and setting an owner password threw 'Nullable object must have a value'; permission flags alone had no effect.

items.title: MigraDoc: table with rows having a KeepWith value exceeding the row count
items.summary: A row KeepWith that reaches past the last table row makes rendering throw instead of being clamped to the table end.

items.title: Correct Pdf Sharp Watermark Wiki
items.summary: The old PDFsharp 1.5 wiki's watermark sample uses XFontStyle; upstream documentation.

items.title: Error when signing malformed docs (fix available)
items.summary: Signing (or importing pages from) a file whose page /Annots points at a missing object threw.

items.title: MigraDoc: Page Orientation Landscape not working, is always in Portait
items.summary: Landscape orientation ignored after section.PageSetup = DefaultPageSetup.Clone(); documented 6.2 breaking change, call ResetPageSize().

items.title: Issue opening PDF files after update to recent preview version
items.summary: Opening some Acrobat forms failed with a duplicate key in ReadAllObjectStreamsAndTheirReferences; fixed upstream in 6.2.0 Preview 3 and a later 2025 release (baseline).

items.title: Missing dependencies
items.summary: FileNotFoundException for Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions in .NET Framework and web apps; caused by host binding redirects and mixed versions, not by the library.

items.title: PdfDocument -> PageCount crashing after saving
items.summary: PdfDocument.PageCount throws 'The document was already saved' after Save, while Pages.Count still works.

items.title: Create PDF 1.4 PDFs
items.summary: Asks whether PDF 1.4 files can be written; setting document.Version = 14 does it.

items.title: The output PDF cannot be opened with Adobe Acrobat Pro 2022
items.summary: An edited PDF cannot be opened in Acrobat Pro 2022; neither the source PDF nor the code was provided.

items.title: Adds option to enable annotation copying - and other PdfSharpCore Features
items.summary: Request to copy page annotations (and ideally the form fields behind widgets) when importing pages, as PdfSharpCore offered.

items.title: Setting the border color of a cell bricks SetEdge()
items.summary: After a cell border colour is set, Table.SetEdge(..., Edge.Interior, BorderStyle.None, 0) no longer removes all interior borders; some stay, partly in the cell colour and partly in the default colour.

items.title: AddImage() uses wrong image from cache
items.summary: MigraDoc reused the first image for later images whose colour bits were identical and only the alpha mask differed; fixed upstream in 6.2.0 Preview 2 (baseline).

items.title: XImage.FromStream failed to get image from MemoryStream
items.summary: XImage.FromStream failed for a MemoryStream created from a byte array (buffer not publicly visible); it works in FreePDF. The suggested automatic rewind is not implemented: a second FromStream on a stream left at its end throws.

items.title: An item with the same key has already been added
items.summary: Opening a form failed with 'An item with the same key has already been added'; no file was shared.

items.title: Unexpected token '00000000000001588776'
items.summary: A startxref value with 13 leading zeros was rejected as an unexpected token; fixed upstream in Lexer.ScanNumber in 6.2.0 Preview 3 (baseline).

items.title: PDF shows multiple document version for multiple signature
items.summary: The reporter wants two signatures to appear in one revision; each signature is necessarily its own incremental update, so viewers list Rev. 1 and Rev. 2.

items.title: Not all .restext files have been removed
items.summary: Building MigraDoc 6.2.0 Preview 2 still produced a de\MigraDoc.Rendering.resources.dll satellite assembly; FreePDF builds produce no PdfSharp or MigraDoc resource satellites.

items.title: StackOverflow when opening big file
items.summary: StackOverflow opening a 20,000+ page file in 6.1.1; the file was never provided. A synthetic 25,000-page file opens quickly, and page-tree traversal is iterative.

items.title: 6.2.0 Preview 2 cannot read certain files
items.summary: Files with deflated object streams, or objects listed in more than one object stream, could not be read by 6.2.0 Preview 2; fixed upstream in Preview 3 (baseline).

items.title: PdfReader.Open will not open a document
items.summary: Bluebeam files whose streams have the right /Length but are followed by more than 11 bytes of blank lines before endstream fail with 'Cannot retrieve stream length', because the endstream search window is only /Length + 20 bytes; duplicate of open upstream #186.

items.title: Error when accessing PdfDocument.AcroForm.Fields
items.summary: When an incremental update reuses the object number of the previous revision's cross-reference stream for its AcroForm, FreePDF lets the old xref stream overwrite the newer object, so the form vanishes, and the obsolete AcroForm getter then replaces it with an empty form.

items.title: PdfReader.Open fails with error "Token '60' was not expected
items.summary: An indirect object that lacks its 'endobj' keyword makes PdfReader.Open throw "Token 'N' was not expected" (N being the next object's number) instead of tolerating the omission as other readers do.

items.title: warning NU1903: Package 'System.Formats.Asn1' 8.0.0 has a known high severity vulnerability
items.summary: Building against the 8.0.0 cryptography packages pulled in a System.Formats.Asn1 version with a known advisory.

items.title: Opening PDF fails with "Stream cannot be read. Please send us the PDF file so that we can fix this"
items.summary: A metadata stream whose /Length runs past the end of the file (empty stream from scanner software) stopped the document from opening.

items.title: Inserting an imported document with InsertRange() throws an exception if the imported document contains hyperlinks
items.summary: The reported exception does not occur, but InsertRange still mishandles internal links: each one is written twice, once still pointing at a hidden page copy outside the page tree (with /P to another orphan page) and once correctly remapped; AppendPages gets it right.

items.title: PDFSharp v6.2 not FIPS compliant
items.summary: Drawing an image threw on FIPS-enforcing machines because the image de-duplication used .NET's MD5.

items.title: PDFSharp support for Linux
items.summary: Asks whether the library runs on Linux.

items.title: glyph issues with  unicode characters
items.summary: Telugu (and other complex scripts) render with wrong glyphs because combining characters and ligatures are not shaped.

items.title: Support for Spot Colours
items.summary: Request to draw with Separation (spot) colour spaces, which print shops need for special inks such as white.

items.title: Stream cannot be read. Please send us the PDF file so that we can fix this.
items.summary: Opening a large PDF from an Azure stream failed with 'Stream cannot be read'; upstream also found loading object streams took hours.

items.title: Error Opening PDF file.
items.summary: Opening a PDF fails with 'Unexpected character' in a stream; no file was provided.

items.title: MeasureString error
items.summary: MeasureString's height leaves out the font's line gap, while XTextFormatter advances lines by GetHeight (which includes it), so a rectangle sized from MeasureString drops the last line for fonts with a line gap; MeasureString also returns single-line height for text with line breaks.

items.title: Several of my images are hashing to the same value
items.summary: Different images were merged into one because their de-duplication hash collided.

items.title: PdfReaderException when reading PDF generated from Google Slides
items.summary: PDFs exported from Google Slides failed with 'Name expected' in the trailer.

items.title: "Object already in table."
items.summary: Reading SecuritySettings.PermitPrint of a permission-restricted document threw 'Object already in table' in ReadOnly/Import mode.

items.title: PDFSharp 6.2 preview.1 multiple digital signatures
items.summary: Signing an already signed document again invalidated the first signature because there were no incremental updates.

items.title: Image Selector collision causes the wrong image to be drawn
items.summary: Two different images drew as the first one because their image selectors collided.

items.title: Import pdf file error
items.summary: A damaged scanner PDF failed with 'Stream cannot be read' on import.

items.title: XGraphics.DrawImage() PNG image without transparency
items.summary: A transparent PNG drawn onto a PDF 1.3 file comes out opaque: the soft mask is silently dropped and the version is not raised.

items.title: Bug: not able to import document.
items.summary: A Bluebeam file with about 35 wrong /Length values does not open because the 'endstream' recovery only searches /Length+20 bytes, and one image stream has 20 newline bytes before 'endstream'.

items.title: Infinite Loop in ‎TopDownFormatter::FormatOnAreas
items.summary: MigraDoc looped forever in TopDownFormatter.FormatOnAreas on a paragraph whose inline images do not fit one page.

items.title: The actual digest length is larger than the approximation made
items.summary: ECDSA signatures vary in length, so some signings failed with 'actual digest length is larger than the approximation'.

items.title: Init-only properties cannot be used directly from .NET Framework projects
items.summary: DigitalSignatureOptions uses init-only setters, which C# 7.3 (the .NET Framework default) cannot call.

items.title: PdfReader.Open throws when trying to get Length of non-seekable Stream
items.summary: PdfReader.Open needs a seekable stream with a Length; a non-seekable network stream must be copied to a MemoryStream first.

items.title: Async IO should be supported
items.summary: Asks for async reading and saving.

items.title: LzwDecode might omit characters
items.summary: The LZW decoder's branch for a code that is not yet in the table writes the previous string without appending its first byte, so one byte is lost each time that case occurs.

items.title: ImageSelector hash ignores transparency mask
items.summary: Two PNGs that differ only in their alpha mask were merged because the hash ignored the mask.

items.title: XFA and XDP Package Cannot update in PDF
items.summary: The reporter wants to change the XFA datasets of a permissions-only encrypted government form without its owner password; FreePDF can do this with PdfReaderOptions.AllowModifyWithoutOwnerPassword in Modify or Append mode (raw streams only, no XFA API).

items.title: Exception: WidthCannotBeNegative
items.summary: MeasureString sums glyph widths in an int: very long strings overflow, giving a wrong width or a WidthCannotBeNegative exception.

items.title: Color.Parse() throws ArgumentException
items.summary: Color.Parse("#2F5C3A") threw and swallowed an ArgumentException internally, slowing code down.

items.title: 异常:The encryption revision value must be 6 for encryption version 5.

items.title: Initial findings
items.summary: Four reading defects: FlateDecode skipped PNG predictors, encrypted object streams were not decrypted, the V5 R6 key salt was wrong, and invalid AES padding aborted reading.

items.title: Allow explicit Unicode sequences for rendered glyphs
items.summary: Lets a RenderTextEvent handler attach a Unicode string to a painted glyph so that a ligature glyph extracts as its original characters through the ToUnicode map.

items.title: Use replaced glyph count when painting render-text events
items.summary: When a RenderTextEvent handler replaces two glyphs with one, DrawString keeps painting with the original count and indexes past the shorter array.

items.title: Keep cross-run CJK closing marks with preceding text
items.summary: A CJK closing bracket or quote in its own text run right after other text is moved alone to the start of the next line instead of staying with (hanging after) the preceding text.

items.title: Avoid repainting identical shared table borders
items.summary: MigraDoc strokes a border shared by two adjacent cells twice, and the later cell's shading can partly cover the first stroke, so shared edges can look heavier or shifted.

items.title: Keep adjacent styled ASCII runs on one line
items.summary: A word made of adjacent runs with different formatting (regular 1, bold 5, italic 0) is broken between the runs at a line end even though the whole word fits on the next line.

items.title: Discard a rejected tab at a line break
items.summary: A tab that no longer fits at the end of a full line is processed again at the start of the next line, indenting the following text to the first tab stop.

items.title: Continue probing past ignored blanks after tabs
items.summary: A blank right after a tab is ignored during formatting, and ProbeAfterTab stops there, so the tab forces a line break although the following text fits.

items.title: Fix default tab stops near the formatting area's right edge
items.summary: Default tab stops near the right edge are dropped because an absolute tab position is compared with the area's relative width; in FreePDF this hits every ordinary body paragraph, since the body area starts at the left margin.

items.title: Fix duplicate registration when prepending PDF page content
items.summary: PdfContents.PrependContent registered the new content stream twice, throwing 'Object already in table' on a reopened page.

items.title: Keep nonbreaking-space text together across formatted runs
items.summary: Text joined by a no-break space is split at that space when its two sides are in different runs (italic 'online:\u00a0' followed by a URL run).

items.title: Encode supplementary code points as UTF-16BE in ToUnicode maps
items.summary: ToUnicode maps write code points above U+FFFF as raw hex (<1F600>) instead of a UTF-16BE surrogate pair, so emoji and math letters extract as the wrong character.

items.title: Keep single underlines continuous across formatted spaces
items.summary: An underlined space with a smaller font size between underlined words gets its own thinner underline segment, so the underline looks uneven.

items.title: Treat null /DecodeParms entries as default filter parameters
items.summary: A /DecodeParms array entry that is null (as DocuSign writes) made Filtering.Decode return nothing and drawing the page as an XPdfForm throw.

items.title: Fix invisible 4-bit indexed PNG with transparency (#392)
items.summary: 4-bit palette PNGs with tRNS got an all-zero soft mask because the alpha offset was never advanced, so the image was invisible.

items.title: Fix #389: PDFsharp misreads C2PA manifest stream as external file
items.summary: A stream dictionary with /F (as in ChatGPT PDFs with a C2PA manifest) made the reader throw 'File streams are not yet implemented'; the PR also adds a C2PA manifest reader API.

items.title: Print the visual representation of a digital signature
items.summary: The signature widget had no annotation Print flag, so the visible signature did not print.

items.title: Add append-only incremental update (ModifyIncremental + PdfDocument.SaveIncremental)
items.summary: Adds incremental saving that appends new and changed objects after the unchanged original, so existing signatures stay valid and further signatures can be added.

items.title: Write rectangles with the precision of real numbers
items.summary: PdfWriter rounds rectangles to three decimals, so a /MediaBox of 595.2756 is saved as 595.276 and later signatures see the page as changed.

items.title: Give each signature field a unique name
items.summary: Every new signature field was named Signature1, colliding with an existing signature field.

items.title: Define the polyfills of DynamicallyAccessedMembers only where they are missing
items.summary: The DynamicallyAccessedMembers polyfills are compiled for every target below .NET 8, which breaks a build for net6.0 or net7.0 with CS0433.

items.title: Fix data race in MigraDoc FontHandler's single-entry font cache
items.summary: FontHandler.FontToXFont kept the last Font and XFont in two separate statics, so concurrent rendering could return another document's font size.

items.title: Fixing invalid lengths beyond hardcoded threshold #347
items.summary: When 'endstream' is more than about 20 bytes away from where /Length says the stream ends (extra line feeds, or a /Length that is too short), the file cannot be opened.

items.title: Fix ScanName() to correctly decode non-UTF-8 name objects (Shift-JIS, GBK, etc.)
items.summary: Names holding legacy code-page bytes (Shift-JIS, GBK) are not decoded or are corrupted, in both the file lexer and the content-stream lexer.

items.title: Fix GetMinMergedCell for cells spanning all columns and multiple rows
items.summary: A table cell merged across all columns and several rows made GetMinMergedCell throw InvalidOperationException.

items.title: Header/Footer fix for PDF
items.summary: In PDF output a tall header or footer overlaps the body text, while RTF output moves the body to make room.

items.title: HeaderFooter fix for PDF
items.summary: Withdrawn first version of the header/footer overlap fix.

items.title: Fix nested composite glyph closure in font subsetter, fixes #348
items.summary: The font subsetter resolved composite glyphs only one level deep, so nested components were missing from subsets.

items.title: Add the ability to change the blending mode
items.summary: Set a blend mode (Multiply, Darken, ...) on XGraphics for drawing into a PDF.

items.title: NewFigure on XPath did not correctly start a new subpath.
items.summary: StartFigure without a preceding CloseFigure did not start a new subpath at the right point.

items.title: Fix to correctly realize the miter limit.
items.summary: The pen's miter limit is written only in some cases and not as set.

items.title: Fix to correctly realize the miter limit.
items.summary: Closed first version of the miter-limit fix.

items.title: Upgrade-to-NET10
items.summary: Undescribed upgrade of upstream's projects to .NET 10.

items.title: Upgrade/net10/tier 3
items.summary: Undescribed companion upgrade of upstream's projects to .NET 10.

items.title: Add support for PDF RunLengthDecode filter
items.summary: Decode streams that use the RunLengthDecode filter.

items.title: Some valid JPEG files may not be loaded using XImage.FromFile()
items.summary: JPEGs without any APPn header (no JFIF or Exif) were rejected by XImage.FromFile.

items.title: [Refactoring] - use ConcurrentDictionary in font caches
items.summary: Performance refactoring that replaces the locked font-cache dictionaries with ConcurrentDictionary.

items.title: Add Hebrew-script RTL run preprocessing and unit tests
items.summary: Reverse Hebrew right-to-left runs before drawing so Hebrew text reads in the right order.

items.title: Improvements to Incremental Digital Signatures and PDF/A-1a Compliance
items.summary: Incremental signing that keeps earlier signatures valid, and keeping PDF/A-1a conformance (no /Group, synchronised XMP) when signing.

items.title: fix: support radial gradients and extended gradients
items.summary: Realize XRadialGradientBrush and the gradient Extend flags in PDF output.

items.title: XImage.FromFile/FromStream throws InvalidOperationException (Unsuported image format.) for valid JPGs.
items.summary: JPEGs whose entropy-coded data contains stuffed FF 00 bytes were rejected as an unsupported image format.

items.title: Fix malformed log string in PdfObjectID.cs
items.summary: A broken log message template in PdfObjectID threw FormatException while opening some documents.

items.title: fix issue #71 (Exception when pointing multiple PdfFileSpecification to a single PdfEmbeddedFileStream)
items.summary: Two file specifications cannot share one embedded file stream: the second constructor registers the stream again and throws.

items.title: Compatibility options
items.summary: Adds nine writer/reader switches (no renumbering, CRLF, no line break after '[' and so on) so output looks like Acrobat's; the Ricoh print failure behind it came from a line break after '[' in arrays.

items.title: Keep /A element when reading PdfOutline
items.summary: A bookmark's /A action (GoTo with a chained /Next JavaScript action) was replaced by a /Dest when the outline was read, losing the action chain.

items.title: Create the PdfAcroFieldEnumerator for PdfAcroFieldCollection
items.summary: Enumerating the form's field collection yields PdfItem/PdfReference instead of typed field objects, unlike the indexer.

items.title: fix issue #248 (signature failing when document is malformed)
items.summary: Signing throws when a page's /Annots refers to an object that does not exist (issue #248, PrinceXML files).

items.title: Handle line feed character in EOD marker for base85 decoder
items.summary: The ASCII85 decoder rejects whitespace (a line feed) inside the '~>' end marker.

items.title: Make working with AcroForms more user-friendly and allow creating PDFs with minmal size
items.summary: AcroForm overhaul: create fields and widgets from scratch, OFL standard-14 font substitutes with a StandardFontResolver, overridable per-type appearance renderers, form import, GetAllFields, real flattening, and non-embedded standard fonts for minimal files.

items.title: RTF: Fix of very wide images (50 cm +)
items.summary: RTF output of a very wide image (over about 50 cm at its native size) is sized wrongly in Word, because \picwgoal holds the native size and \picscalex the reduction, and Word clamps the goal but keeps the scale.

items.title: Add Support for Rendering Text as Paths in PDF Generation
items.summary: Option to render chosen MigraDoc text as vector paths so it cannot be selected or copied.

items.title: Make PDFSharp compatible with trimming
items.summary: Make the libraries safe for trimming and Native AOT (annotations so the trimmer keeps reflection targets, no trim warnings).

items.title: XMP metadata: correct datetime format for CreateDate and ModifyDate
items.summary: XMP CreateDate/ModifyDate were written without a time zone, so PDF/A validators reported a mismatch with the Info dictionary.

items.title: Ensure all trailers security handlers are initialized at parsing time
items.summary: With several trailers, the security handlers of earlier trailers were used before their /Encrypt entry was read, which threw.

items.title: Support inline dictionaries for Encrypt tag
items.summary: A trailer /Encrypt given as a direct dictionary instead of a reference was not supported.

items.title: Support Version 5 Revision 5 decryption
items.summary: Decrypt files that use Adobe's deprecated AES-256 handler, /V 5 /R 5.

items.title: Improve resilience against malformed or corrupt documents
items.summary: Open damaged files that viewers open: ignore a stray ')', search to EOF for a stream whose /Length is far too short, read UTF-16LE strings, and rebuild the cross-reference table by scanning when startxref or the table is broken.

items.title: Fixes #127 Check for existence of gdiImage comes to late
items.summary: In the GDI build, images from MemoryStreams were hashed after GDI had read the stream, so every image got the empty-input hash and the first was reused for all.

items.title: Used `nameof()` instead of string literals in places where it was needed
items.summary: Code style: nameof() instead of string literals, with small refactorings; no behaviour change.

items.title: Expose PDFSharp.Drawing.Interpolate as MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes.Image.Interpolate
items.summary: Expose image interpolation on MigraDoc images so small QR codes are not blurred.

items.title: Support glyph-colors (e.g. Emojis)
items.summary: Render coloured glyphs (COLR/CPAL fonts such as Segoe UI Emoji) in colour.

items.title: Proposal: Incremental saving
items.summary: Incremental saving (an Append open mode that writes only changed objects) so signed documents can be stamped or signed again.

items.title: Add optional point argument to AddDocumentLink
items.summary: Let a document link point at a position on the target page, not just the page.

items.title: Add `Value` and `this[string name]` to PdfItem.
items.summary: Convenience members PdfItem.Value (dereference) and a string indexer so object trees can be walked without casts and .Elements.

items.title: DebuggerTypeProxy for COperator and printing method that is easier to…
items.summary: CSequence.Copy (behind Clone) is broken; the PR also adds a debugger view for content operators.

items.title: MigraDoc support for rendering barcodes and PDFSharp support for Code 128 barcodes
items.summary: Render barcodes in MigraDoc and add Code 128 to PDFsharp.

items.title: Fix slowness in decoding hexadecimal string
items.summary: Hexadecimal string scanning said to be slow because of Char.ToUpper.

items.title: Use lazy loading for object-streams and their objects
items.summary: Load objects from object streams lazily, so a newer revision's copy in a new object stream wins (issue #46) and missing objects are handled (issue #73).

items.title: Lazy-load object-streams and their objects
items.summary: Earlier attempt at lazy loading of object streams (superseded by #85).

items.title: Fix issue #80 (allow detection of JPEG APP2 ICC_PROFILE headers)
items.summary: JPEGs whose only application segment is APP2 ICC_PROFILE were rejected as 'Unsupported format'.

items.title: Refactor XLineAlignment for clearer vertical text alignment descriptions
items.summary: Clarify XLineAlignment's comments: what Near, Center and Far mean for a layout rectangle versus a point.

items.title: Basic support for files larger than 2GB
items.summary: Read and write PDF files larger than 2 GB.

items.title: Handle incorrect/missing length of stream-objects.
items.summary: Recover a stream whose /Length is wrong or missing by scanning for 'endstream'.

items.title: Add TextWithShapeFormat to support fBehindDocument
items.summary: RTF: a TextWithShapeFormat property that writes fBehindDocument so text can sit on top of shapes.

items.title: Handle xref-streams based on their file-position (last one first)
items.summary: Read xref streams newest first, so a newer revision's object copies win (issue #46).

items.title: Support of Digital Signatures (PKCS#7) + TSA timestamp
items.summary: Digital signatures (PKCS#7) with an optional TSA timestamp.

items.title: expose PdfString's start and end bytes positions in Stream
items.summary: Expose a PdfString's byte positions in the output so an extension can compute a signature byte range.

items.title: PdfSharp core project now multi-targets netstandard2.0 + net6.0
items.summary: Multi-target the core library to .NET Standard 2.0 as well as modern .NET.

items.title: do not replace existing XMP metadata if any
items.summary: Do not replace XMP metadata that the document or the developer already has.

items.title: add CheckSum to PdfEmbeddedFileStream
items.summary: Fill /CheckSum (the MD5 of the file) on embedded file streams.

items.title: implement PdfFileAttachmentAnnotation
items.summary: A usable file attachment annotation: create it from a file specification or embedded file, with an icon or a custom appearance, plus a page helper.

items.title: Brush painting from a image
items.summary: A brush that fills shapes with an image (XImageBrush).

items.title: JPEG - Photoshop 8BIM support
items.summary: JPEGs from Photoshop with only an APP13 (8BIM) segment were rejected.

items.title: Add assets
items.summary: Adds test assets to the repository; upstream keeps assets on a separate site.

items.title: Update to use real font in PdfTextForm
items.summary: Text fields should use the font, size and alignment from the field's /DA and /Q instead of a hard-coded Courier New (issue #9).
